findings: Relationship direction/occlusion, all four screenshots: the exact candidate cache-read-through connection is API Server -> Redis, but the gray vertical cache stroke coincides with the final pink Auth Provider -> API Server descent. The only clearly readable endpoint arrow is the downward pink arrow into API; the arrow toward Redis is not visually distinguishable near the Redis lower edge/read-through label. This prevents the image alone from reliably conveying the required API-to-Redis direction.

Relationship occlusion, all four screenshots: the AWS Region: us-west-2 title background masks a horizontal segment of the Auth Provider verify-JWT route. At 2048 light/dark this is approximately x480-690 at y371; at 1440 it is approximately x328-480 at y270. The title remains readable, but its placement interrupts an unrelated semantic connection.
